mapper.select: SELECT placeType, id, canteenId, stallId, name, canteenName, canteenType, location, description, merchantName FROM ( SELECT 'CANTEEN' AS placeType, c.id AS id, c.id AS canteenId, NULL AS stallId, c.name AS name, c.name AS canteenName, c.type AS canteenType, c.location AS location, c.description AS description, NULL AS merchantName, c.sort_order AS canteenSortOrder, 0 AS stallSortOrder, CASE WHEN c.name = #{keyword} THEN 0 WHEN c.name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 4 END AS matchRank FROM canteen c WHERE c.status = #{status} AND ( c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) UNION ALL SELECT 'STALL' AS placeType, s.id AS id, c.id AS canteenId, s.id AS stallId, s.name AS name, c.name AS canteenName, c.type AS canteenType, s.location AS location, s.description AS description, m.name AS merchantName, c.sort_order AS canteenSortOrder, s.sort_order AS stallSortOrder, CASE WHEN s.name = #{keyword} THEN 0 WHEN s.name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN c.name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN m.name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS matchRank FROM stall s INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = s.canteen_id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.stall_id = s.id AND m.apply_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.status = #{status} WHERE s.status = #{status} AND c.status = #{status} AND ( s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) places ORDER BY matchRank ASC, canteenSortOrder ASC, stallSortOrder ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id, c.campus_id AS campusId, c.name, c.type, c.location, c.description, c.opening_hours AS openingHours, c.status, c.average_score AS averageScore, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM stall s WHERE s.canteen_id = c.id AND s.status = #{status} ) AS stallCount FROM canteen c WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.status = #{status} LIMIT 1
